* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, The right bank of the river overflows
downstream of confluence and about 1/4 mile upstream from the
gaging station.

- At 7:45 AM EDT Tuesday the stage was 12.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 11.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 13.0 feet
this afternoon. It will then fall below flood stage late this
afternoon.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 11 at 9:29AM CDT until August 11 at 10:15AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
At 928 AM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Durand to Davis Junction to near Sublette,
moving east at 55 mph. This line of storms has a history of
producing wind damage.

HAZARD...70 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect considerable tree damage. Damage is likely to mobile
homes, roofs, and outbuildings.

Locations impacted include...
Rockford, Beloit, Loves Park, Machesney Park, Dixon, Roscoe,
Rochelle, South Beloit, Rockton, Byron, Oregon, Mount Morris, Amboy,
Polo, Rockford Airport, Cherry Valley, Winnebago, Davis Junction,
Pecatonica, Forreston, Durand, Hillcrest, Stillman Valley, Franklin
Grove, and Ashton.
properties.instruction:
Remain alert for a possible tornado! Tornadoes can develop quickly
from severe thunderstorms. If you spot a tornado go at once into the
basement or small central room in a sturdy structure.

Prepare immediately for damaging winds and deadly cloud to ground
lightning. Seek shelter inside a well-built structure. Stay away from
windows.

properties.areaDesc: Somerset, PA
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 11 at 8:29AM EDT until August 11 at 11:30AM EDT by NWS State College PA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is occurring.

* WHERE...Southwestern Somerset County in south central
Pennsylvania...

* WHEN...Until 1130 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Numerous roads
remain closed due to flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 825 AM EDT, local law enforcement reported flooding in the
warned area.  Between 3 and 5 inches of rain have fallen.
- A Flood Watch remains in effect through 5 AM Wednesday.
Additional heavy rainfall is possible.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Meyersdale, Ursina, New Centerville, Mount Davis, Rockwood,
Confluence, Salisbury, Garrett, Addison, Wellersburg, Casselman,
Callimont and Seven Springs.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

In hilly terrain there may be low water crossings. Do not attempt to
cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

properties.areaDesc: Coshocton, OH; Guernsey, OH; Muskingum, OH; Noble, OH; Tuscarawas, OH
properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 11 at 7:18AM EDT until August 11 at 11:15AM EDT by NWS Pittsburgh PA
properties.description:
FFWPBZ

The National Weather Service in Pittsburgh has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Coshocton County in east central Ohio...
Western Guernsey County in east central Ohio...
Muskingum County in east central Ohio...
West Central Noble County in east central Ohio...
Western Tuscarawas County in east central Ohio...

* Until 1115 AM EDT.

* At 718 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across or approaching the warned area. Between 0.5 and 1
inch of rain has fallen with an additional 1 to 3 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Zanesville, Coshocton, Newcomerstown, New Concord, West Lafayette,
Sugarcreek, South Zanesville, North Zanesville, Dresden,
Frazeysburg, Baltic, Philo, Warsaw, Pleasant Grove, Cumberland,
Conesville, Fultonham, Plainfield and Nellie.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.areaDesc: Garrett, MD
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 11 at 8:58AM EDT until August 11 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall
continues.

* WHERE...A portion of western Maryland, including the following
county, Garrett.

* WHEN...Until 200 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Roads remain closed due to flooding. Low-water crossings
are inundated with water and may not be passable. It will take
several hours for all the water from these storms to work
downstream.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 854 AM EDT, the Casselman River at Grantsville has crested
and is now receding, although flooding continues. Emergency
Management reports high water along the Cassleman River at
Durst Road, Jennings Road, Dung Hill Road, Bittinger Road,
and Maple Grove Road.
- Additional showers and thunderstorms may reach the area after
11 AM.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Bittinger...                       Grantsville...
Friendsville...                    Accident...
Jennings...                        Keysers Ridge...
New Germany...                     Mineral Spring...
Merrill...                         Selbysport...
Piney Grove...
- Please visit www.weather.gov/safety/flood for flood safety
and preparedness information.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.
